name: manual_eacd61
claim: A script shared byte-identically across orama-system and Perpetua-Tools that uses bash-4-only features (mapfile, associative arrays, etc.) silently breaks on any machine whose only bash is macOS's stock 3.2.57 (no GNU bash 4+ installed) -- check 'bash --version' before relying on bash 4 builtins in any shared git hook, and prefer a portable 'while IFS= read -r' loop over mapfile.

decisions.notes: scripts/git/check_markdown_lint.sh (identical in both repos, wired into .githooks/pre-commit) used 'mapfile -t FILES < <(...)' which errors as 'mapfile: command not found' under bash 3.2, failing the hook on EVERY commit on this machine regardless of what was staged -- it failed before ever reaching the no-staged-.md-files early exit. Discovered 2026-10-13 only because it blocked an unrelated exa-mcp-daemon.py commit; fixed in orama PR #400, needs the same portable-loop fix applied in PT's copy of the script (and ideally a verify-guard-parity / sync-attribution-guard-scripts pass since these shared scripts are supposed to be kept byte-identical).
